sources.name: E_PRESENT_PHOTO-permit.txt
sources.text:
Scene 701 close-ups of the historical photograph require written image-owner consent, lint-free cotton gloves and a paper conservator beside the table throughout the take.

Scene 702 interviews require written sound-stage access consent.

An unsigned proposal for Scene 703 lists a smoke observer; this draft imposes no current filming requirements.
